selection: smallest individuals_per_cell passing all thresholds in every frozen robustness scenario

interpretation.fit_success: At least 95% of simulations must produce a usable frozen-model fit in every required robustness scenario.
interpretation.h1: At least 80% directional two-sided rejection for the frozen H1 SESOI in every required robustness scenario.
interpretation.h2: At least 80% hierarchical H2 pass, including H1 gatekeeping, in every required robustness scenario.
interpretation.monte_carlo: At least 1000 simulations per scenario; the same simulation count must be used across all candidate N and robustness scenarios.

firewalls: thresholds cannot be changed after the final operating-characteristic surface is visible
a failing robustness scenario cannot be averaged away
the smallest passing counterbalanced N must be selected mechanically
H1/H2 SESOI values remain frozen separately in validation/routeability_sesoi_gate_v1.json
claim_ceiling: This rule fixes the design operating-characteristic threshold. It does not determine the nuisance/baseline robustness grid or the final N before pilot nuisance inputs exist.
